reviewed_by: Codex root source contract and actual command review2026-10-25
review_notes: DeepDiff LFUCache CacheNode.free_myself must preserve middle_unlink_scope. Set returns cached hits, distinct keys isolated, eviction removes least-frequent and recompute restores. All original F2P/P2P retained. Smith patch introduces defect. Off-policy.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'deepdiff/lfucache.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('deepdiff.lfucache')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
from deepdiff.lfucache import LFUCache
c = LFUCache(5)
c.set("a", value="1")
c.set("b", value="2")
c.set("c", value="3")
assert c.freq_link_head.count_caches() == 3
c.get("b")
print("head_after_middle_promote", c.freq_link_head.count_caches())
assert c.freq_link_head.count_caches() == 2
assert ("a" in c) is True
assert ("b" in c) is True
assert ("c" in c) is True
assert c.get("a") == "1"
assert c.get("b") == "2"
assert c.get("c") == "3"
print("middle_unlink_scope", True)
c2 = LFUCache(2)
c2.set("x", value="1")
c2.set("y", value="2")
assert c2.get("x") == "1"
c2.set("z", value="3")
assert ("x" in c2) is True
assert ("y" in c2) is False
assert ("z" in c2) is True
print("evict_isolation", True)
c2.set("y", value="2-recomputed")
assert c2.get("y") == "2-recomputed"
print("recompute", True)

PYREPLAY
